boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: Lecture on the nature of magic by Archmage Tarelion.
entries.target: 大法师泰尔兰关于魔法本质的演讲。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The dwarf finally returns with a vial and a small pouch.*#WHITE#
I put a bit of the good stuff in this one, though it won't do you any favors tomorrow morning. And careful with that Taint of Purging, especially if the wife answers the door the next time you knock. Har!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那个矮人终于回来了，手里拿着一个药瓶和一个小袋子。*#WHITE#
这里面我给你带来个好东西，尽管也许明天早上对你没什么用。小心使用这个“清除印记”,如果下次你敲门的时候，是我老婆开门的话，你可要小心点，哈！

entries.source: An elf dressed in glowing robes.
entries.target: 一位穿着鲜艳长袍的精灵。

entries.source: Entrance to some ancient elven ruins
Surround yourself with Wildfire, increasing all your fire damage by %0.1f%%, ignoring %d%% fire resistance of your targets and reducing self-inflicted fire damage by %d%%.
entries.target:
使身上缠绕火焰，增加 %0.1f%% 所有火系伤害并无视目标 %d%% 火焰抗性。
		同时，减少 %d%% 对自己造成的火焰伤害。

entries.source: The target is poisoned, taking %0.2f blight damage per turn and decreasing all heals received by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标中毒，每回合受到 %0.2f 枯萎伤害并降低所有治疗效果 %d%%。
这个傀儡遭受过严重的破坏。

entries.source: It is a massive animated statue.

While shrouded in cursed miasma you gain stealth (%d power) and %d physical power.
		The stealth power and physical power will increase with your mindpower.
entries.target:
当你被包裹在诅咒瘴气中时，你获得潜行 (%d 强度)，并获得 %d 物理强度。
		潜行强度和物理强度受精神强度加成。

entries.source: Light gloves which do not seriously hinder finger movements, while still protecting the hands somewhat.
entries.target: 轻便的手套不仅不影响手指的活动，还会多多少少保护手的安全。

entries.source:
Conjures up a bolt of lightning, doing %0.2f to %0.2f damage (%0.2f average) and dazing the target for 3 turns.
		If the target resists the daze effect it is instead shocked, which halves stun/daze/pin resistance, for 5 turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
召唤一道闪电，对目标造成 %0.2f ～ %0.2f 闪电伤害（平均 %0.2f），并使其眩晕 3 回合。
		如果目标抵抗了眩晕效果，则转而受到“震撼”效果，震慑、眩晕和定身抗性减半，持续 5 回合。
		伤害随法术强度提高。

entries.source: The target is immune to further damage but is dealing %d%% less damage.
entries.target: 目标免疫伤害，但造成的伤害减少 %d%%。

entries.source:
Surround yourself with a myriad of tiny, nearly invisible, reinforcing fungi.
		You gain %d maximum life and %d life regeneration.
		The effects will increase with your Willpower.
entries.target:
使你自身周围环绕无数微不可见、有治疗作用的孢子。
		你获得 %d 最大生命值，%d 生命回复。
		效果受意志值加成。

entries.source: He points in the direction of the Riljek forest to the north.
entries.target: 他指着北方的里尔约克森林。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Go at once to Last Hope to report those events!
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#立刻到最后的希望汇报所发生的情况！

entries.source: #CRIMSON##Source# shares some damage with a shadow!
#LIGHT_RED#%s writhes in agony as a fragment of its mind is destroyed!
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#%s痛苦地扭动着，它的一片精神碎片被摧毁了！

entries.source: This power seems too much to wield; you fear it might absorb YOU.
entries.target: 这件装备的力量太强大了，你害怕它会把你吸收进去。

entries.source:
Fire a shot at the target tile that blinds enemies for %d turns, marks them for 2 turns and illuminates the area within radius %d for %d turns. Enemies within the illuminated area lose %d defence and stealth power and cannot benefit from concealment.
		The status chance increases with your Accuracy, and the defense reduction with your Dexterity.
entries.target:
发射闪光弹，致盲敌人 %d 回合，标记他们 2 回合并照亮 %d 格范围 %d 回合。范围内的敌人降低 %d 闪避和潜行强度，不能从隐匿技能得到任何加成。
		状态效果几率受命中加成，闪避削减受敏捷加成。

entries.source: Unique (fixed) bosses advance in bonus classes 30% faster
entries.target: 独有（固定）Boss 的额外职业等级提升速度快 30%

entries.source: Arrows are used with bows to pierce your foes to death.

A shroud of darkness seems to fall across your path.
#CRIMSON#Penalty : #WHITE#Shroud of Weakness: Small chance of becoming enveloped in a Shroud of Weakness (reduces damage dealt by %d%%) for 4 turns.
#CRIMSON#Power 1+: %sNightwalker: %+d Darkness Resistance, %+d%% Max Darkness Resistance, %+d See Invisible
#CRIMSON#Power 2+: %s%+d Luck, %+d Constitution
#CRIMSON#Power 3+: %sShroud of Passing: Your form seems to fade as you move, reducing all damage taken by %d%% for 1 turn after movement.
#CRIMSON#Power 4+: %sShroud of Death: The power of every kill seems to envelop you like a shroud, reducing all damage taken by %d%% for 3 turns.
entries.target:
一道黑暗屏障降临在你的面前。
#CRIMSON# 惩罚：#WHITE# 虚弱之纱：有较小几率被虚弱之纱包裹（使你造成的伤害降低 %d%%）持续 4 回合。
#CRIMSON# 强度 1+：%s 暗夜行者：%+d 暗影抗性，%+d%% 最大暗影抗性，%+d 看破隐形强度
#CRIMSON# 强度 2+：%s%+d 幸运，%+d 体质
#CRIMSON# 强度 3+：%s 穿越屏障：你的身形在移动时消失，移动后 1 回合减少 %d%% 所受伤害。
#CRIMSON# 强度 4+：%s 死亡屏障：每一次杀死目标可以让你笼罩在一个屏障内，减少 %d%% 所受伤害持续 3 回合。

entries.source: This helmet radiates a dark power. Its visor seems to twist and corrupt the vision of its wearer. You feel worried that if you were to lower it for long, the visions may affect your mind.
entries.target: 这顶头盔散发着黑暗的力量。它似乎能够扭曲和腐化装备者的视觉。你担心如果长时间放下护面，那些幻象可能会影响你的心智。

entries.source: Dwarves are a secretive people, hailing from their underground home of the Iron Throne.
entries.target: 矮人是一支隐秘的种族，生活于地下世界钢铁王座。

entries.source:
Sends a torrent of searing darkness through your foes, doing %d darkness damage. There is a 25%% chance the rushing darkness will blind them for 3 turns and cause them to lose track of their target.
		If you know the Creeping Darkness talent, a short-lived trail of darkness is left in the beam's wake. Its damage is identical to that of Creeping Darkness's.
		The damage will increase with your Mindpower. You do +%d%% damage to anything that has entered your creeping dark.
entries.target:
向敌人发射一股灼热的黑暗能量，造成 %d 点伤害。黑暗能量有 25%% 概率致盲目标 3 回合并使它们丢失当前目标。
			如果你掌握黑暗之雾技能，会在射线范围内留下短暂的黑暗尾迹，其伤害等同于黑暗之雾的伤害。
			伤害受精神强度加成。你对任何进入黑暗之雾的人造成 +%d%% 点伤害。

entries.source: You have prevented the portal to the Void from opening and thus stopped the Creator from bringing about the end of the world.
entries.target: 你阻止了虚空传送门的开启，并终止了世界末日的到来。

entries.source: New Class Evolution: #LIGHT_GREEN#Avatar of a Distant Sun (Sun Paladin)
entries.target: 新职业进阶：#LIGHT_GREEN#日耀神使（太阳骑士）

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#Welcome to ToME 4#LAST#

The #GOLD#Dungeon of Adventurer Enlightenment#WHITE# awaits you ahead!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#欢迎来到 ToME 4#LAST#

#GOLD#冒险者启蒙地下城#WHITE#就在前方等着你！

entries.source: The spiders in your barn won't do. You'll know a giant spider when you see one, though they're rare in Maj'Eyal.
entries.target: 你家仓库里的蜘蛛是不行的。当你看到一只时，你就会明白什么是巨型蜘蛛，尽管在马基·埃亚尔这种蜘蛛很稀少。

entries.source:
Turn your body into pure ice, increasing your Cold damage affinity by %d%% and your physical resistance by %d%%.
		You have a %d%% chance to shrug off all direct critical hits (physical, mental, spell).
		The effects increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
将你的身体转化为纯净的寒冰体，你受到的寒冰伤害的 %d%% 会治疗你，同时你的物理抗性增加 %d%%。
		你有 %d%% 几率摆脱暴击伤害（物理，精神，法术）。
		效果受法术强度加成。
使你精通于使用单手武器加盾牌的战斗技能。

entries.source: Have sided with Slasul and killed Ukllmswwik
entries.target: 站在萨拉苏尔一方并且杀死乌克勒姆斯维奇

entries.source: It is a tougher relative of the Xorn. Its hide glitters with metal ores.
entries.target: 它是索尔石怪更难对付的近亲，表皮闪烁着金属矿石的光泽。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +2 魔法，-2 意志，+2 灵巧

entries.source: A small acorn, crafted crudely out of iron.
entries.target: 一颗用铁粗制而成的小橡果。

entries.source: This deep black leather armor, wrapped with thick silk, is icy cold to the touch.
entries.target: 这件黑色的皮甲上覆盖着一层厚厚的丝绸，触感冰凉。

entries.source: The target gains 1 extra parry opportunity each turn, and its chance to fail each parry is reduced by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标每回合获得一次额外的用匕首招架攻击的机会，招架失败率下降 %d%%。
